content_sections.heading: HPRCA Radiographer Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF Download
content_sections.text: HPRCA Radiographer Recruitment 2026 Notification Name of the Post: HPRCA Radiographer Online Form 2026 Post Date: 03-11-2026 Total Vacancy: 43 Brief Information: The Himachal Pradesh Rajya Chayan Aayog (HPRCA), Hamirpur has released a notification for the recruitment of 43 Radiographer (Job Trainee) vacancies in the Department of Health & Family Welfare and the Department of Medical Education & Research, Himachal Pradesh. Eligible candidates who meet the educational qualifications, age limit and registration requirements can read the notification and Apply Online.

rows.himachal_pradesh_rajya_chayan_aayog_hprc: Application Fee All Categories: Rs. 800/- Examination Fee: Rs. 100/- Processing Fee: Rs. 700/- Application Correction Fee: Rs. 100/- Payment Mode: Online (Debit Card/Credit Card/Net Banking)

HPRCA Recruitment 2026 Important Dates Notification Date: 03-11-2026 Starting Date for Apply Online: 12-11-2026 (10:00 AM) Last Date for Apply Online: 07-12-2026 (11:59 PM) Application Correction Window: Four Days, commencing three days after the application closing date CBT/Written Examination Date: To Be Announced Admit Card Date: To Be Announced

HPRCA Recruitment 2026 Age Limit Minimum Age: 18 Years Maximum Age: 45 Years Age Calculated As On: 01-01-2026 Upper Age Relaxation: Up to 5 Years for eligible SC/ST/OBC/PwD candidates of Himachal Pradesh, HP Government employees and HP Ex-Servicemen, as applicable under the prescribed rules.

Qualification Candidates must have passed 10+2 in Science from a recognized Board or University. Must possess a recognized B.Sc. Degree in Medical Radiology & Imaging, Radiography, Radiation Technology, Medical Imaging Technology or an equivalent discipline listed in the official notification. Must be registered with the Himachal Pradesh Para Medical Council, Shimla (presently State Allied Health Care Council, HP). Candidates should have passed Matriculation and 10+2 from an institution situated in Himachal Pradesh. This condition does not apply to Bonafide Himachalis. Knowledge of Himachal Pradesh customs, manners and dialects is desirable.

Salary Post Name: Radiographer (Job Trainee) Consolidated Fixed Amount: Rs. 18,000/- Per Month Engagement will be governed by the Himachal Pradesh Job Trainee Policy, as specified in the notification.
Selection Process Computer Based Test (CBT) or Written Screening Test Document Verification Final Selection as per HPRCA Recruitment Rules

Exam Pattern Total Questions: 120 Total Marks: 120 Examination Duration: 90 Minutes Question Type: Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) Technical Subjects: Questions based on the prescribed essential qualification. General Subjects: Himachal Pradesh General Knowledge, Current Affairs, Everyday Science, Logical Reasoning, Social Science, General English and General Hindi. Examination Mode: CBT/Written Screening Test as decided by HPRCA.

HPRCA Radiographer Apply Online 2026 The HPRCA Radiographer Recruitment 2026 online application process will begin on 12 November 2026 at the official website hprca.hp.gov.in. Candidates must complete One Time Registration before filling out the Online Recruitment Application (ORA). Application Starting Date: 12-11-2026 Last Date: 07-12-2026 Application Mode: Online Official Portal: hprca.hp.gov.in HPRCA Radiographer Apply Online - Click Here

How to Apply for HPRCA Radiographer Recruitment 2026? Visit the official HPRCA website at hprca.hp.gov.in . Click on the Sign Up option for One Time Registration (OTR). Complete registration with the required personal details, educational qualifications and other information. Upload the prescribed photograph, signature and required documents. Complete the candidate profile. Open the available vacancies and select Radiographer (Job Trainee), Post Code 26061 . Click Apply for the relevant post. Select the preferred examination district from the available options. Review all details in the application form carefully. Pay the applicable examination and processing fee online. Submit the completed application and download a copy for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for HPRCA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 7 December 2026. Applications opened on 12 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in HPRCA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 43 vacancies: 19 Radiographer (Job Trainee) - Department of Health & Family Welfare, HP, 24 Radiographer (Job Trainee) - Department of Medical Education & Research, HP.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for HPRCA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 7 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: All categories (examination fee Rs. 100 + processing fee Rs. 700): Rs. 800.00. Correction fee: Rs. 100.00.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 45 years (as on 1 January 2026). Relaxation: SC/ST/OBC/PwD domiciles of HP, HP Government employees, Ex-servicemen of HP Up to 5 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Consolidated fixed amount Rs. 18,000 for Radiographer (Job Trainee) - Department of Health & Family Welfare, HP, Consolidated fixed amount Rs. 18,000 for Radiographer (Job Trainee) - Department of Medical Education & Research, HP.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 10+2 in Science from a recognized Board of School Education/University; B.Sc. Medical Technology (Radiology & Imaging) or another listed radiography/radiation/medical imaging degree from a recognized University; registration with the Himachal Pradesh Para Medical Council, Shimla (Presently State Allied Health Care Council, HP). The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be registered with the Himachal Pradesh Para Medical Council, Shimla (Presently State Allied Health Care Council, HP). Must be registered on the One Time Registration (OTR) portal before filling the ORA. Reserved category candidates of other states are treated as General (UR) without reservation or fee concession.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Dismissed from any previous service. Convicted of an offence involving moral turpitude, bound down for good conduct, or permanently debarred from any examination or selection. Found directly or indirectly influencing the selection process. Married to a person having a living spouse, or having more than one living spouse.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Computer Based Test / Written Screening Test (120 marks, 1½ hours). Document verification. 120 multiple-choice questions, 1 mark each. Subjects up to the level of the prescribed essential qualification.
